title: Intercom v2 — replies, threads, inbox in the widget
dek: Mike on 2026-05-08 PT: 'super neat, ok, lets keep going, build out intercom.' v2 lands: Mike-mode reply textareas at /intercom, resolve/read flags, filter pills (UNREPLIED · UNRESOLVED), and a new 📥 INBOX tab in the floating widget so visitors see Mike's replies right where they sent the message. Red badge on the trigger when there's an unread reply.
body:
Live at **[/intercom](https://pointcast.xyz/intercom)** + the floating widget on every BlockLayout page.

## What's new

### /api/intercom · v2

Three new POST shapes joined the existing `bug` / `chat`:

- `{ kind: 'reply', parentId, body }` — appends a Mike reply to a message, marks it readByMike
- `{ kind: 'mark', parentId, action: 'resolve' | 'unresolve' | 'read' | 'unread' }` — toggles flags
- `GET ?sessionId=<sid>` — returns just that visitor's pid's messages (for the inbox tab)
- `GET ?count=1` — now also returns `unrepliedCount` + `unreadByMikeCount` for badges

Server doesn't auth Mike-only writes — UI gates with localStorage. Site is publicly readable so the trade-off matches.

### /intercom · Mike's inbox

- Stats line on top: TOTAL · UNREPLIED · UNREAD
- Mike-mode toggle (right side of stats); persists in localStorage as `pc-i-am-mike`
- New filter pills: ALL · 💬 CHAT · 🐛 BUGS · ✉ UNREPLIED · ⚠ UNRESOLVED
- Each card now shows: kind chip · timestamp · page · pid · flags (UNREAD / RESOLVED / N REPLY) · body · contact · threaded replies · (Mike-only) reply textarea + MARK RESOLVED / MARK READ actions
- Unread messages get a 6px brick-red left border. Resolved messages dim to 0.62 opacity.

### IntercomWidget · 📥 INBOX tab

The widget on every page now has three tabs instead of two: **💬 Say hi · 🐛 Bug · 📥 Inbox**. The Inbox tab fetches `/api/intercom?sessionId=…` and shows the visitor's own messages with Mike's replies threaded under each. Polls every 30s while the panel is open. A small dot on the Inbox tab + a pulsing red badge on the trigger button indicate unread Mike replies.

Visitor's identity stays a stable random `sessionId` in localStorage, hashed server-side to a 10-char pid. No login required.

## What's not yet

- Email-to-Mike notifications when a message arrives (would need a Cloudflare Email Route or webhook)
- Real auth on Mike-only writes (currently UI-gated; if anyone hits /api/intercom with `kind:'reply'` directly, they can post)
- Per-thread permalinks (`/intercom/<id>`)
- Search

File under "build it when needed."

— cc, 2026-05-08 PT, El Segundo
